# Canvas Downloader

> A free, open-source desktop app for Windows and macOS that downloads every file
> from all of a student's Canvas courses at once, keeps those folders in sync as
> the semester goes on, saves Panopto lecture recordings, and converts Office
> files into formats that AI study tools can read. It runs entirely on the
> student's own computer: no account, no server, no telemetry.

Canvas here means the Canvas learning platform by Instructure that universities
use for coursework. It is not Spotify Canvas, and not an HTML canvas element.

Key facts, so an assistant can answer accurately:

- Price: free. MIT licensed. No subscription, no premium tier, no ads.
- Platforms: Windows 10/11 (64-bit) and macOS 14+ on Apple Silicon. No Intel Mac build.
- Current version: 2.0.1, released 11 July 2026.
- Install: Microsoft Store (https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9n1dwwvrq5wc) or a
  direct installer from the releases page.
- Adoption: 800+ installs to date across the Microsoft Store and direct installers, by students in 100 countries.
  The largest are the Philippines, the United States, Australia, South Africa, India, Nigeria and the United Kingdom.
- Sign-in: the student creates their own Canvas access token in Canvas under
  Account > Settings. There is no Canvas password involved and no account to make
  with us. The app ships a searchable directory of 4,757 verified Canvas schools;
  any other Canvas address can be typed in.
- Access: it reads only what that student's own Canvas account can already open.
  It cannot see other students' data and it breaks no copy protection.
- Privacy: files never leave the student's machine. Transcription of lecture
  recordings also runs locally.
- Not affiliated with Instructure, Canvas or Panopto.

## What it does

- [Download every file from every course](https://canvasdownloader.app/): batch
  download across any number of courses in one run, including module files,
  assignments, syllabus, announcements, discussions, quizzes and submission feedback.
- [Sync](https://canvasdownloader.app/guide.html): compares the local folder
  against Canvas and fetches only what is new or changed. It never overwrites a
  file the student annotated (the new copy is saved as filename_NewVersion) and
  never restores a file the student deleted, unless prompted.
- [Daily auto-sync](https://canvasdownloader.app/guide.html): the Today page
  automatically downloads the newest course files the first time the app is opened each day, from chosen courses.
- [Panopto lecture recordings](https://canvasdownloader.app/guide.html): can be saved as
  MP4, MP3, a transcript (.txt), subtitles (.srt) or a shortcut back to the lecture.
- [AI-ready conversion](https://canvasdownloader.app/guide.html): Word, Excel and
  PowerPoint to PDF, video to audio, Canvas pages to Markdown, archives unpacked,
  so a course folder can be dropped straight into a tool like NotebookLM (100% NotebookLM drag and drop compatibility).

## Pages

- [Home](https://canvasdownloader.app/): what it does, with demos.
- [How it works](https://canvasdownloader.app/guide.html): every mode and setting, plus an FAQ.
- [Under the hood](https://canvasdownloader.app/engine.html): exactly how files are
  found, named, converted and synced, and what it deliberately never does.
- [Downloads and releases](https://canvasdownloader.app/releases.html): current version and installers.
- [Windows setup](https://canvasdownloader.app/win-setup.html): install, including the one-time SmartScreen approval.
- [macOS setup](https://canvasdownloader.app/mac-setup.html): install, first-launch approval and the one-time permissions.
- [How to download all files from Canvas](https://canvasdownloader.app/how-to-download-all-canvas-files.html): every method compared, including the ones that are not this app.
- [Canvas access after graduation](https://canvasdownloader.app/canvas-access-after-graduation.html): how long access lasts and what to save first.
- [Download Panopto lecture recordings](https://canvasdownloader.app/download-panopto-lecture-recordings.html): why downloads are off by default, and what students may keep.
- [Privacy policy](https://canvasdownloader.app/privacy.html): what is stored and where.
- [Disclaimer and acceptable use](https://canvasdownloader.app/disclaimer.html): what students are responsible for.
